title: 关税压力下：中国供应链仍是优势，强管理公司长期受益？
speaker: Michelle Cheng

segments.en: But of course, I think on the other side, there are a lot of the trade tensions. And they are not alone, actually, if we look at the aggregate overseas revenues, momentum across all the consumer companies we cover, past one year was very tough.
segments.zh: 但当然，另一方面，有很多贸易紧张。而且它们并非个例，如果看我们覆盖的所有消费公司的海外收入总势头，过去一年非常艰难。

segments.en: You have tariff impact, actually, not only on the payroll sheet, but actually on a lot of companies. And there's a wall inflation pressures.
segments.zh: 有关税影响，实际上不仅影响工资表，还影响很多公司。还有通胀压力。

segments.en: But if a company is, they really have a strong advantage strength, supply chain management, big response to market. And all we know, we think, well, the Chinese company's strength is really light on the supply chain management.
segments.zh: 但如果一家公司真的有很强的优势、供应链管理、对市场的快速反应。而且我们知道，我们认为中国公司的优势确实在于供应链管理。

segments.en: So, for those companies, not only she made these, also a very good example, a few names, they actually can still benefit from a longer-term perspective, if they are really strong in the supply chain management.
segments.zh: 所以对那些公司来说，不仅是她提到的，还有几个很好的例子，如果它们在供应链管理上真的很强，从长期看实际上仍能受益。

segments.en: Michelle, it's great to have you.
Michelle, check their co-head of the Asia Consumer Research at Goldman Sachs.
segments.zh: Michelle，高盛亚洲消费研究联席主管。
